changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment:
Canonicalise every stored Defra Identity relationship id to lower-case, and de-duplicate the rows that case variation may already have created.
Relationship ids are GUIDs, which are case-insensitive (RFC 4122), and Defra ID does not emit a single canonical spelling: the id_token from a refresh_token grant carries the same currentRelationshipId as the sign-in token in a different case. The application now compares them case-insensitively and writes them canonicalised (src/db/persist-session.js), but uq_roles_user_rel_name and uq_relationships_user_rel are plain text uniques — so without this migration a canonicalised write would MISS an existing differently cased row and insert a second one instead of updating it. A later status change (access removed, status 6) would then land on only one of the pair, leaving a stale approved row that the case-folded RBAC EXISTS in src/db/project-visibility.js would still honour: access retained after revocation.
Where a case-duplicate pair exists, the most recently updated row wins — that is the one the latest sign-in wrote, so it carries the current enrolment status. On data that is already lower-case (the expected case in every environment) every statement here matches no rows and the changeset is a no-op.
